contract: Persistent local platform account assignments reference authoritative AppConfig agent profiles and existing social registrations. Requested/active/paused/revoked lifecycle enforces current revisions, single active owner, dependency readiness and durable reason history. Existing approval and credential authority remain unchanged.
acceptance: Real AppConfig profiles and registered social-account references, strict rejection of unknown identities
Idempotent request and optimistic transition provenance; terminal revoke and single active owner
Agent removal/account changes invalidate current readiness without losing audit records
Actual native/HTTP/Console lifecycle journeys and current-home isolation
limits: Local assignment metadata does not grant tool permission, provision external accounts or revoke external credentials.
External provisioning remains provider-specific residual; existing credential and destructive-action approval boundaries stay authoritative.

qualification.external_provisioning: not implemented; local assignment lifecycle only
